jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Core Product
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We’re building the AI infrastructure powering the future of financial operations - starting with automating the most painful and complex workflows in loan servicing.

  • Backed by a16z and Y Combinator, with $65M raised in Series A funding.

  • 8-figure ARR < 2 years already serving > 20% of the auto lending industry, and processing millions of real customer calls and transactions daily.

  • Fully deployed with major financial institutions - not just PoCs.

  • We are expanding into new financial services segments!

  • In-person office culture in San Francisco, CA.

We're fully integrated with our customers, own the full stack, and are moving fast to bring modern AI into regulated industries where precision, reliability, and performance matter most.

About the Role

We're seeking a Software Engineer - Core Product to help us reshape how millions of loans are serviced through artificial intelligence. As a Product Engineer at Salient, you'll build and enhance our AI platform that automates and improves every aspect of loan servicing - from payment processing to fraud prevention to customer support. You will be responsible for both the 0→1 MVP development and the 1→10 growth and scaling of a product. You'll work directly on features that help lenders better serve their customers while improving compliance and reducing risk.

Responsibilities

  • Develop complete features across both frontend and backend layers of our application

  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code with appropriate test coverage

  • Troubleshoot and debug complex issues across the technology stack

  • Optimize application performance and scalability

  • Own both product manager and software engineer responsibilities

  • Balance technical considerations with user needs and business goals

  • Incorporate customer feedback into product and features

Requirements

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience

  • Strong Python proficiency

  • Proven track record of shipping user-focused products

  • Excellence in cross-functional collaboration and communication

  • Deep empathy for user needs and passion for user experience

  • Enjoy being hacky - getting something out to the customer as soon as possible

  • Experience building scalable systems

  • We’re hiring for full stack and backend roles

  • Ability to work 4 days a week from our San Francisco office (open to candidates willing to relocate)

Nice to Have

  • Experience in highly regulated industry

  • Combination of both big tech and start-up experience

  • Knowledge of auto loan servicing

At Salient, we’re building at the edge of AI - fast, focused, and with real ownership. Sprints and major launches move quickly, and we look for people who are energized by that pace and ready to collaborate in person 4 days a week in our San Francisco office with a start time of 8:00 AM.

We also offer a benefits package designed to support our full-time employees: medical, dental, and vision coverage, a generous 401(k), and catered lunches.

By applying, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We’re building the AI infrastructure powering the future of financial operations - starting with automating the most painful and complex workflows in loan servicing.

  • Backed by a16z and Y Combinator, with $65M raised in Series A funding.

  • 8-figure ARR < 2 years already serving > 20% of the auto lending industry, and processing millions of real customer calls and transactions daily.

  • Fully deployed with major financial institutions - not just PoCs.

  • We are expanding into new financial services segments!

  • In-person office culture in San Francisco, CA.

We're fully integrated with our customers, own the full stack, and are moving fast to bring modern AI into regulated industries where precision, reliability, and performance matter most.

About the Role

We’re hiring an Applied AI Engineer to design, build, and scale the systems that power our next-generation voice AI platform.

You’ll work across the stack - from LLM fine-tuning and retrieval pipelines to real-time voice interactions - delivering production-grade systems that learn from real users in the wild.

This is a hands-on role focused on fast iteration, technical depth, and measurable impact in production.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop multimodal AI systems with a focus on natural, real-time voice interactions

  • Implement safety and alignment frameworks for LLM-driven user experiences

  • Build scalable monitoring systems to detect and respond to unexpected model behavior

  • Balance rapid feature deployment with long-term system reliability and scalability

  • Ensure compliance with financial and data safety regulations

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and research teams to ship quickly and iterate continuously

What You’ll Bring

  • 2+ years of experience working directly with LLMs or voice AI technologies (voice experience is a plus, not required)

  • Deep expertise in LLM development (RAG, fine-tuning, prompt design, evaluation)

  • Proven ability to ship and maintain production AI systems at scale

  • Strong background in ML systems design and engineering best practices

  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

  • Based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco (4 days/week in office)

At Salient, we’re building at the edge of AI - fast, focused, and with real ownership. Sprints and major launches move quickly, and we look for people who are energized by that pace and ready to collaborate in person 4 days a week in our San Francisco office with a start time of 8:00 AM.

We also offer a benefits package designed to support our full-time employees: medical, dental, and vision coverage, a generous 401(k), and catered lunches.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Front-End
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We’re building the AI infrastructure powering the future of financial operations - starting with automating the most painful and complex workflows in loan servicing.

  • Backed by a16z and Y Combinator, with $65M raised in Series A funding.

  • 8-figure ARR < 2 years already serving > 20% of the auto lending industry, and processing millions of real customer calls and transactions daily.

  • Fully deployed with major financial institutions - not just PoCs.

  • We are expanding into new financial services segments!

  • In-person office culture in San Francisco, CA.

We're fully integrated with our customers, own the full stack, and are moving fast to bring modern AI into regulated industries where precision, reliability, and performance matter most.

About the Role

We're looking for a Software Engineer for our Front-End to build powerful, intuitive interfaces that help users navigate and act on complex data. You’ll work closely with product, design, and AI teams to craft elegant UIs, define frontend architecture, and ship features that directly improve the user experience at scale.

You’ll be an early and visible member of a small, fast-moving engineering team - owning end-to-end features, contributing to UI strategy, and helping shape the future of our product as we scale beyond voice.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement responsive, performant user interfaces using React + TypeScript

  • Translate complex workflows into simple, usable product experiences

  • Collaborate across product, design, and AI teams to build and iterate quickly

  • Help define frontend architecture and build reusable UI components

  • Build data visualizations that make financial data clear and actionable

  • Work closely with backend engineers to integrate APIs and services

  • Ship clean, testable, maintainable code on a rapid release cycle

  • Advocate for the user in product and engineering discussions

What you’ll bring

  • 4+ years of experience building production front-end applications

  • Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript, modern JavaScript, and front-end tooling

  • Deep understanding of responsive design, browser performance, and accessibility

  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., Chart.js, D3, etc.)

  • Customer-obsessed mindset - you actively engage with users, understand their workflows, and translate their pain points into product improvements

  • Strong sense of ownership and bias for action - you move quickly, make pragmatic trade-offs, and care deeply about delivering value to real customers

  • Thrives in an environment where product feedback comes directly from production users and enterprise partners

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally

  • Located in (or willing to relocate to) San Francisco

At Salient, we’re building at the edge of AI - fast, focused, and with real ownership. Sprints and major launches move quickly, and we look for people who are energized by that pace and ready to collaborate in person 4 days a week in our San Francisco office with a start time of 8:00 AM.

We also offer a benefits package designed to support our full-time employees: medical, dental, and vision coverage, a generous 401(k), and catered lunches.

By applying, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Staff Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We’re building the AI infrastructure powering the future of financial operations - starting with automating the most painful and complex workflows in loan servicing.

  • Backed by a16z and Y Combinator, with $65M raised in Series A funding.

  • 8-figure ARR < 2 years already serving > 20% of the auto lending industry, and processing millions of real customer calls and transactions daily.

  • Fully deployed with major financial institutions - not just PoCs.

  • We are expanding into new financial services segments!

  • In-person office culture in San Francisco, CA.

We're fully integrated with our customers, own the full stack, and are moving fast to bring modern AI into regulated industries where precision, reliability, and performance matter most.

About the Role

We're looking for a Staff Infrastructure Engineer to architect and own the systems that power Salient at scale. This is a high-impact IC role focused on infrastructure engineering - you'll define how we build, deploy, and operate the infrastructure that processes millions of real financial transactions and customer interactions daily. You'll set the technical direction for reliability, scalability, and developer velocity across the stack to make sure the platform can support whatever we're building next.

Why us?

  • We are one of the fastest-growing companies in the Voice AI space. We quadrupled our revenue last year and are now handling close to a million calls per day.

  • You’ll have an insane amount of ownership and be part of our journey as we undergo exponential growth, both in business and in engineering.

  • We are an AI-native company, constantly staying ahead of the curve in AI tooling and engineering best practices. You’ll play a direct role in driving this forward.

  • We have a no-BS culture that is hyper-focused on building a successful (and highly profitable) business.

What You'll Do

  • Lead architectural decisions and technical reviews for infrastructure-critical initiatives.

  • Design, build, and own the cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) that runs Salient - from compute and networking to storage and observability.

  • Develop scalable harnesses that enable coding agents to operate reliably without compromising system stability or code quality.

  • Partner closely with the modeling team to optimize the serving and performance of GPU-intensive workloads.

  • Drive reliability and performance across the stack by defining SLOs, building robust monitoring and alerting, and leading incident response and postmortems.

  • Own developer platform investments that materially improve engineering velocity, including CI/CD, deployment tooling, environments, and internal infrastructure abstractions.

  • Establish infrastructure best practices, patterns, and standards as a technical authority across the engineering org.

  • Identify and reduce technical debt across infrastructure systems, with a focus on long-term scalability and operational health.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years at the senior or staff level in infrastructure/platform roles, working on large-scale distributed systems.

  • Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS or GCP) - compute, networking, storage, IAM, and cost optimization.

  • Expert in infrastructure-as-code, with a strong track record of building scalable automation systems.

  • Extensive experience owning and scaling Kubernetes and CI/CD systems in high-throughput, production environments.

  • Track record of building and operating high-availability, high-throughput distributed systems with mature observability practices.

  • Strong technical communication - able to document architecture clearly and influence engineering decisions across teams.

Nice to Have

  • Background in security.

  • Exposure to serving AI/ML workloads.

  • Combination of big tech and startup experience.

At Salient, we’re building at the edge of AI - fast, focused, and with real ownership. Sprints and major launches move quickly, and we look for people who are energized by that pace and ready to collaborate in person 4 days a week in our San Francisco office with a start time of 8:00 AM.

We also offer a benefits package designed to support our full-time employees: medical, dental, and vision coverage, a generous 401(k), and catered lunches.

By applying, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Founder's Office
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We’re building the AI infrastructure powering the future of financial operations - starting with automating the most painful and complex workflows in loan servicing.

  • Backed by a16z and Y Combinator, with $65M raised in Series A funding.

  • 8-figure ARR < 2 years already serving > 20% of the auto lending industry, and processing millions of real customer calls and transactions daily.

  • Fully deployed with major financial institutions - not just PoCs.

  • We are expanding into new financial services segments!

  • In-person office culture in San Francisco, CA.

We're fully integrated with our customers, own the full stack, and are moving fast to bring modern AI into regulated industries where precision, reliability, and performance matter most.

The Role

You'll sit in the Founder's Office and act as force-multiplier to the CEO and leadership team. This is not a "coordination" role—this is an execution role. You'll take ambiguous, cross-functional problems (GTM, product ops, compliance ops, customer delivery, internal cadence) and drive them to crisp plans, clear owners, and shipped outcomes.

If you're the kind of person who can go from "figure out what's broken" → "write the plan" → "align stakeholders" → "project-manage to completion" without needing permission every step, you'll thrive here.

What You'll Do

CEO / Founder Enablement

  • Own the CEO's operating cadence: weekly priorities, OKR/KR tracking, meeting hygiene, decision logs, follow-ups.

  • Turn leadership conversations into action: write crisp memos, capture decisions, assign owners, drive closure.

  • Prepare internal/external meetings: briefs, stakeholder maps, agendas, talking points, and post-meeting execution.

Strategic & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Run special projects across Product, Eng, Compliance, Sales, and Customer Success (often simultaneously).

  • Build lightweight systems: dashboards, templates, playbooks, and operating routines that scale.

  • Drive "0→1" initiatives: new customer onboarding plans, pilot definitions, KPI frameworks, pricing/packaging analysis, process redesign.

GTM / Customer Delivery Ops

  • Support enterprise deal execution: proposal/SOW hygiene, pricing models, redline coordination, mutual action plans.

  • Create customer-ready artifacts: exec-friendly updates, ROI/KPI reporting, launch comms, rollout plans.

  • Own the details on high-stakes timelines: dependencies, risk flags, escalation paths.

Compliance / Quality / Governance (core to our space)

  • Help operationalize compliance: tracking policy updates, QA workflows, audit-ready documentation, evidence collection.

  • Maintain discipline around change management: what changed, why, who approved, what's the rollout plan.

Internal Operations

  • Improve internal throughput: planning rituals, meeting structures, hiring process upgrades, tooling choices.

  • Partner with Finance/BizOps on budgeting, vendor management, and operational metrics as needed.

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

  • You've built a reliable founder/leadership operating cadence (priorities, KPIs, decision logs, follow-up system).

  • 2–4 cross-functional projects are moving faster because you're driving alignment and execution.

  • Leadership is spending less time on coordination and more time on decisions.

  • Customer launches and deliverables are cleaner: clearer owners, fewer surprises, tighter comms.

Who You Are

  • High-agency operator: you proactively diagnose problems and drive solutions end-to-end.

  • Structured thinker: you write clearly, make crisp plans, and turn ambiguity into concrete next steps.

  • Low ego, high standards: you do what it takes, and you care about quality.

  • Fast learner: you can ramp quickly in complex, regulated domains.

  • Trustworthy: you handle sensitive information with discretion.

  • Comfortable with intensity: early-stage pace, shifting priorities, and high expectations.

Preferred Background (not required)

  • 2–6 years experience in a demanding environment: startup ops, consulting, banking/fintech ops, product ops, investment/strategy, or founder-led roles.

  • Prior work with enterprise customers and/or regulated workflows (finance, insurance, healthcare).

  • Strong writing: memos, project plans, customer updates, specs.

Skills We Care About

  • Project management (real execution, not just status updates)

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication

  • Analytical ability (Excel/Sheets, basic modeling, KPI design)

  • Stakeholder management (execs + ICs, internal + external)

  • Operational rigor (process, documentation, follow-through)

At Salient, we’re building at the edge of AI - fast, focused, and with real ownership. Sprints and major launches move quickly, and we look for people who are energized by that pace and ready to collaborate in person 4 days a week in our San Francisco office with a start time of 8:00 AM.

We also offer a benefits package designed to support our full-time employees: medical, dental, and vision coverage, a generous 401(k), and catered lunches.

By applying, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

 - You've built a reliable founder/leadership operating cadence (priorities, KPIs, decision logs, follow-up system).

 - 2–4 cross-functional projects are moving faster because you're driving alignment and execution.

 - Leadership is spending less time on coordination and more time on decisions.

 - Customer launches and deliverables are cleaner: clearer owners, fewer surprises, tighter comms.


WHO YOU ARE

 - High-agency operator: you proactively diagnose problems and drive solutions end-to-end.

 - Structured thinker: you write clearly, make crisp plans, and turn ambiguity into concrete next steps.

 - Low ego, high standards: you do what it takes, and you care about quality.

 - Fast learner: you can ramp quickly in complex, regulated domains.

 - Trustworthy: you handle sensitive information with discretion.

 - Comfortable with intensity: early-stage pace, shifting priorities, and high expectations.


PREFERRED BACKGROUND (NOT REQUIRED)

 - 2–6 years experience in a demanding environment: startup ops, consulting, banking/fintech ops, product ops, investment/strategy, or founder-led roles.

 - Prior work with enterprise customers and/or regulated workflows (finance, insurance, healthcare).

 - Strong writing: memos, project plans, customer updates, specs.


SKILLS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Project management (real execution, not just status updates)

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication

 - Analytical ability (Excel/Sheets, basic modeling, KPI design)

 - Stakeholder management (execs + ICs, internal + external)

 - Operational rigor (process, documentation, follow-through)

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We’re building the AI infrastructure powering the future of financial operations - starting with automating the most painful and complex workflows in loan servicing.

  • Backed by a16z and Y Combinator, with $65M raised in Series A funding.

  • 8-figure ARR < 2 years already serving > 20% of the auto lending industry, and processing millions of real customer calls and transactions daily.

  • Fully deployed with major financial institutions - not just PoCs.

  • We are expanding into new financial services segments!

  • In-person office culture in San Francisco, CA.

We're fully integrated with our customers, own the full stack, and are moving fast to bring modern AI into regulated industries where precision, reliability, and performance matter most.

About the Role

We're seeking a Forward Deployed Software Engineer to work directly with our customers to implement our technology and build any required customizations. In this role, you will apply your problem-solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to be a customer’s first resource for implementing AI agents in their company. This role is critical in helping us deliver reliable, compliant, and efficient customer service solutions to millions of borrowers.

Responsibilities

  • You will own the end-to-end implementation and execution of high-stakes customer engagements and projects, determining what the customer requirements are and how best to apply our Voice AI Agent solution

  • Implement and build new features with customers, and implement them in the core engineering product

Requirements

  • Relevant college and post-college work experience in a fast moving work environment

  • Customer-facing polish, with ability to extract requirements and run discovery - strong communicator

  • Ownership mindset — someone who treats every deployment like a mission-critical project

  • Strong hands on coder with proven proficiency in programming languages in either Python, Typescript or Javascript

  • Excellence in technical documentation and cross-team communication

  • Ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical customers, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment with evolving objectives and many iterations with customers

  • Ability to work 4 days a week from our San Francisco office (open to candidates willing to relocate)

  • In-person office culture in San Francisco, CA.

We're fully integrated with our customers, own the full stack, and are moving fast to bring modern AI into regulated industries where precision, reliability, and performance matter most.

Why We're Hiring

We're scaling from 50 to 100+ employees over the next year, with aggressive hiring plans across Engineering, Product, and GTM. We need a recruiter who excels at sourcing, pipeline building, and candidate management to support our rapid growth.

The Role

You'll own sourcing and top-of-funnel recruiting, building robust pipelines and managing candidates through the interview process. You'll report to our CEO and focus on finding great talent, engaging passive candidates, and ensuring exceptional candidate experience.

What You'll Do

  • Source passive candidates through LinkedIn, JuiceBox, YC, and creative outreach

  • Build and maintain healthy pipelines for current and future hiring needs

  • Conduct initial screens to assess background, motivation, and role fit

  • Manage candidate communication throughout the process - scheduling, updates, feedback

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand requirements and ideal profiles

  • Track sourcing metrics - response rates, pipeline health, candidate quality

  • Coordinate interview logistics and keep ATS organized

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years recruiting experience at startups or high-growth tech companies

  • Strong sourcing skills - proven ability to find and engage passive candidates

  • Experience managing large pipelines with multiple active searches

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building

  • Highly organized - manage scheduling and follow-ups without dropping balls

  • Self-starter who takes initiative and problem-solves independently

What Makes This Role Interesting

  • Second recruiting hire - help build our recruiting function from scratch

  • Direct impact on company growth through pipeline building

  • Work closely with founders and leadership

  • Grow into more responsibility as we scale

jobs.title: Head of People
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We’re building the AI infrastructure powering the future of financial operations - starting with automating the most painful and complex workflows in loan servicing.

  • Backed by a16z and Y Combinator, with $65M raised in Series A funding.

  • 8-figure ARR < 2 years already serving > 20% of the auto lending industry, and processing millions of real customer calls and transactions daily.

  • Fully deployed with major financial institutions - not just PoCs.

  • We are expanding into new financial services segments!

  • In-person office culture in San Francisco, CA.

We're fully integrated with our customers, own the full stack, and are moving fast to bring modern AI into regulated industries where precision, reliability, and performance matter most.

Why We're Hiring

We're scaling from 50 to 100+ employees over the next year and need a people leader to take our people function to the next level. We have the basics in place (Rippling, benefits), but we need someone who can build strategic HR infrastructure, shape our culture, and partner with leadership on talent decisions.

The Role

You'll be our first dedicated people leader, evolving our people function from foundational to strategic. You'll own everything from performance management to compensation frameworks, employee relations to culture initiatives. You report to the CEO and partner closely with leadership on all people decisions.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own our people strategy - performance management, compensation, employee development, and culture

  • Partner with leadership on organizational design, headcount planning, and talent decisions

  • Evolve HR infrastructure - refine policies, ensure compliance, optimize benefits programs

  • Design and implement performance management frameworks - goal-setting, reviews, promotion cycles, career development

  • Lead compensation strategy - maintain equitable pay bands, manage equity grants, conduct market benchmarking

  • Drive culture and engagement initiatives - team events, values definition, employee feedback loops, DEI programs

  • Manage employee relations - coach managers on difficult conversations, resolve conflicts, handle sensitive situations

  • Build manager enablement programs - training on feedback, performance management, hiring decisions

  • Ensure compliance with employment laws and regulations across all locations

  • Partner with recruiting lead on hiring strategy and process improvements

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves:

  • 5-8+ years in People/HR roles at high-growth startups, with at least 2 years in leadership

  • Experience scaling people functions at early-stage companies (50-200 employees)

  • Track record designing and implementing people processes (performance management, compensation, onboarding, career frameworks)

  • Business partner mentality - you advise leadership on strategic decisions, not just execute HR tasks

  • Strong coaching skills - you develop managers and help them navigate people challenges

  • Comfort with ambiguity - you build infrastructure without waiting for perfect clarity

  • Excellent judgment on sensitive employee matters

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in fintech, lending, or regulated industries

  • Background in AI/ML or technical product companies

  • Previous experience scaling a company through hyper-growth (50→200+ employees)

  • Knowledge of multi-state employment compliance

What Makes This Role Interesting

  • Take the people function from foundational to strategic as our first people leader

  • Direct partnership with CEO and leadership team on all people decisions

  • Shape company culture during critical growth phase

  • High impact - your work directly affects every employee and shapes our trajectory

At Salient, we’re building at the edge of AI - fast, focused, and with real ownership. Sprints and major launches move quickly, and we look for people who are energized by that pace and ready to collaborate in person 4 days a week in our San Francisco office with a start time of 8:00 AM.

We also offer a benefits package designed to support our full-time employees: medical, dental, and vision coverage, a generous 401(k), and catered lunches.

By applying, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
